description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for version 3.3.3 of the OrangeHRM installer, which executes SQL scripts to update the database schema during migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractMigration and performs database schema updates for version 3.3.3.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes SQL scripts 'dbscript-1.sql' and 'dbscript-2.sql' to perform the migration.

methods.name: execQueries
methods.description: Reads SQL script files, splits into individual statements, and executes each statement against the database.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '3.3.3' indicating the migration version.
